newsitem.title: USA: Wells Aluminum to sell $100 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Wells Aluminum to sell $100 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: Wells Aluminum Corp, a Baltimore, Maryland-based manufacturer of aluminum extrusion and fabricated products, plans to sell $100 million in high-yield bonds in the next several weeks, market sources said.

Proceeds from the offering will be used to pay a $60.6 million special cash dividend to the company's private shareholders and to repay approximately $35.2 million in outstanding debt, according to a confidential prospectus for the offering.
Wells was taken private in a leveraged buyout in 1987, according to market sources. The current junk bond offering will be the company's first since the buyout.
The 144a private placement offering of eight-year senior notes will be underwritten by Merrill Lynch & Co.
